target: every asset with kind=creature in dist/src/data/assets.js
appearance: Keep the existing transparent creature PNG and bottom-center anchor; these states animate the unchanged art so new species inherit them.

travel.method: renderer bob tied to traveled distance

hit.method: simulation strike event: brief flash, recoil and squash

capture.method: simulation orb event: fade and draw inward

reducedMotion: Idle/travel motion and event effects are disabled by the browser preference and the in-game Calm setting.
